headline: Bitcoin Drops Below $80,000 Amid Geopolitical Tensions in Middle East
summary: Bitcoin slid under weekend selling pressure to trade below $80,000, touching its weakest level in more than a month following U.S. evacuations in the Middle East.
why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization and frequently reacts to broader macroeconomic risk-off sentiment.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Escalating geopolitical instability prompts investors to trim exposure to risk assets, including cryptocurrencies.

why_moved: Escalating Middle East tensions and U.S. evacuations sparked broad risk-off sentiment, prompting rapid liquidations in crypto markets.
